description.en: ToTonAI gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness: sign-in in settings and account recharge panel.

title.en: ToTonAI Gateway - GPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek
title.zh: ToTonAI 中转站 - GPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek

description.en: Connect the ToTonAI AI gateway: sign in or create an account right in the DSH settings panel, use the site's text-model catalog (GPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek / Doubao / Grok / GLM), and access the account recharge panel. Account based; upstream API keys never leave the server.
description.zh: 接入 ToTonAI AI 中转站:在 DSH 设置页的 ToTonAI 面板里直接登录或注册,即可查看站点文本模型目录(GPT / Claude / Gemini / DeepSeek / 豆包 / Grok / GLM),并在同一面板查看档位与提交充值申报。账号制,不接触上游 API Key。
